features.claim: It was an enormous, long-necked, long-tailed, four-legged plant-eater.
features.quote: It was an enormous, long-necked, long-tailed, quadrupedal, plant-eater from Argentina, South America during the Cretaceous period.

on four legs

features.claim: It had a long neck that it could use to sweep the ground or reach high up for plants.
features.quote: Argentinosaurus probably used its long neck to sweep the ground or to reach high up in search of vegetation.
